import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    row_groups = []
    start = 0
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == 0 for v in row):
            if start < r:
                row_groups.append(range(start, r))
            start = r + 1
    if start < len(grid):
        row_groups.append(range(start, len(grid)))
    col_seps = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid)]
    col_groups = []
    start = 0
    for c in col_seps:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(range(start, c))
        start = c + 1
    if start < len(grid[0]):
        col_groups.append(range(start, len(grid[0])))
    out = [[0 for _ in col_groups] for _ in row_groups]
    for i, rr in enumerate(row_groups):
        for j, cc in enumerate(col_groups):
            positions = [(r, c) for r in rr for c in cc if grid[r][c] not in (0, 7, 9)]
            # The marked tile has two colored cells in the same column.
            if len(positions) == 2 and positions[0][1] == positions[1][1]:
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''
